content_sections.heading: NCL Medical Consultant Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The speciality-wise vacancy table on page 1 of the notification lists 40 positions:

content_sections.heading: Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree from a recognised institute or college approved by the Medical Council of India. They must also hold a recognised postgraduate degree, DNB or postgraduate diploma in the relevant speciality. Candidates must possess an MBBS degree from a recognised institute or college approved by the Medical Council of India.

content_sections.heading: Experience Requirements
content_sections.text: Retired medical executives must also satisfy the service-record, disciplinary and integrity conditions stated in the notification.

rows.experience_requirement: Minimum 15 years of experience in the relevant speciality, supported by self-declaration

rows.applicant_category: Medical Specialist other than retired executives of CIL, PSUs or government organisations
rows.experience_requirement: Minimum 7 years of experience in the relevant speciality

rows.applicant_category: GDMO other than retired executives of CIL, PSUs or government organisations
rows.experience_requirement: Minimum 3 years of experience as GDMO

content_sections.heading: Order of Preference
content_sections.text: Medical executives retired from CIL or its subsidiaries Retired executives of other Public Sector Undertakings Retired officers of Central or State Government organisations Private practitioners

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: The applicant must not be more than 70 years old during the contract period. The engagement cannot continue after the consultant reaches 70 years of age.

content_sections.heading: NCL Medical Consultant Honorarium
content_sections.text: The honorarium will be paid irrespective of the number of patients examined or treated. Consultants will not receive retirement benefits such as gratuity, provident fund, post-retirement medical benefits or pension for the engagement period.

content_sections.heading: Work Schedule
content_sections.text: Duties include outdoor and indoor services, operative procedures, village health camps and other medical activities. Consultants may be called for additional visits during an emergency with prior approval from the Chief of Medical Services.

rows.minimum_working_requirement: At least three days per week, four hours per day and 6 to 12 visits per month
At least three days per week, eight hours per day and 8 to 12 visits per month

content_sections.heading: Contract Period
content_sections.text: The initial contract will be for one year . It may be extended for one additional year based on satisfactory performance, organisational requirements, availability of vacancies and approval from the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: NCL may shortlist applicants for the interview or selection process. The selection modalities will follow the qualification and engagement criteria used in open recruitment for the respective medical discipline, except for the specified age and experience conditions. No travelling allowance will be paid to candidates for attending the interview or selection process.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Page 8 of the notification instructs applicants to submit the prescribed application form and letter of undertaking with self-attested copies of the following documents: Proof of age or Matriculation certificate Superannuation notice or order, where applicable Updated degree registration certificate with additional qualifications Educational qualification certificates Experience certificates or supporting documents Attempt certificate issued by the university or college Photograph and signature

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NCL Medical Consultant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official NCL website at www.nclcil.in. Open the recruitment notices section. Download the Medical Consultant notification and prescribed application form. Complete the application form and letter of undertaking. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents. Submit the application by post or email before the deadline. The completed application must reach the following address: General Manager (HR)/HOD (EE) Northern Coalfields Limited Singrauli, Madhya Pradesh - 486889 The envelope should be superscribed with “Application for the post of Consultant (Medical Specialist)/Consultant (GDMO), NCL” . Candidates can email the completed application and documents to: [email protected] The email subject should mention “Application for the post of Consultant (Medical Specialist)/Consultant (GDMO), NCL” .

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is part-time and does not provide any right to regular employment in NCL. Medical consultants appointed on an hourly or part-time basis will not receive paid leave. Permanent accommodation will not be provided. Transit accommodation may be provided subject to availability. No TA or DA is payable for attending regular duty. All communication with applicants will generally be sent to the email address entered in the application. NCL may change the vacancies or modify, restrict or cancel the engagement process.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in NCL Medical Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Northern Coalfields Limited has announced 40 vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. Which posts are included in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment includes Consultant (Medical Specialist) posts in different specialities and Consultant (GDMO) posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach NCL by 5:00 PM on 5 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 70 years during the contract period.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for a Medical Specialist?
faq.answer: Candidates require an MBBS degree with a recognised postgraduate degree, DNB or postgraduate diploma in the relevant speciality.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification for a GDMO?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree from a recognised institute or college approved by the Medical Council of India.

faq.question: Q7. What is the honorarium for Medical Specialists?
faq.answer: Medical Specialists will receive Rs.8,000 for each four-hour session.

faq.question: Q8. What is the honorarium for GDMOs?
faq.answer: GDMOs will receive Rs.5,000 for each eight-hour day or session.
